summary: Ownership and influence on Geography nodes: who controls a cell, and what a contested road costs.

coordination.notes: Appends ExpeditionState.ownership at the END of the field list so parallel lanes appending their own fields merge cleanly. WorldEvent lives in world.rs, not expedition.rs; the ControlChanged variant goes on that one enum rather than a second. godot_bridge.rs is lane B3's file and is touched by exactly one line: expedition_error_code's match is exhaustive, so a new ExpeditionError variant cannot compile under --features godot-ext without its arm (the same reason A3 and A4 recorded in that match's own comments). No other bridge surface added here.
